A.why: Only suggestion in either cmdi finding that writes the restructuring as code: new ProcessBuilder("cmd.exe", "/c", "echo", userInput).start(), with the tainted value as a discrete argument and no shell parsing ('userInput' read as bar by the ambiguous-wording rule). Side advice: it hardcodes cmd.exe, which does not exist on the non-Windows path this test actually runs on; a portability defect, not a security one.

B.why: Correct approach in prose (separate argument array, no shell) but no call written.

C.why: Prose only; fixed command plus discrete argument list described but never written as code.

D.why: Prose only. Side advice: allowlist ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ still permits a leading '-', accepted as an option by the invoked command (same as calibration finding 4 and finding 15).

E.why: Generic; restates the Semgrep message (avoid exec, use a whitelist).
